## Trustworthy Language Generation

::: {.publication-card .publication-wide .publication-highlight}
<p class="pub-venue">arXiv · Under Review</p>

### Linguistics-Aware Non-Distortionary LLM Watermarking

Shinwoo Park, **Hyejin Park**, Hyeseon An, Yo-Sub Han

A linguistically adaptive, non-distortionary watermarking framework for
multilingual LLMs, designed to support model-free and publicly verifiable
detection while preserving generation quality.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00613){.pub-link}
:::

::: {.publication-card .publication-wide .publication-highlight}
<p class="pub-venue">ACL 2026 · MAIN CONFERENCE</p>

### A Linguistics-Aware LLM Watermarking via Syntactic Predictability

Shinwoo Park, **Hyejin Park**, Hyeseon An, Yo-Sub Han

A linguistically grounded approach to adaptive and publicly verifiable LLM
watermarking.

[Paper](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.2115/){.pub-link}
:::

::: {.publication-card .publication-wide .publication-highlight}
<p class="pub-venue">AAAI 2026 · ORAL PRESENTATION</p>

### WaterMod: Modular Token-Rank Partitioning for Probability-Balanced LLM Watermarking

Shinwoo Park, **Hyejin Park**, Hyeseon Ahn, Yo-Sub Han

A probability-aware modular framework for balancing watermark detectability and
generation quality.

[Paper](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/40546){.pub-link}

### KHG-Aclair: Knowledge Hypergraph-Based Attention with Contrastive Learning for Recommendations

**Hyejin Park**, Taeyoon Lee, Kyungwon Kim

A recommendation framework that models higher-order relationships through
knowledge hypergraphs and improves representations through contrastive learning.

[Paper](https://jcse.kiise.org/files/V18N3-04.pdf){.pub-link}

### TRIO: An Entity Retrieval Method Using Entity Embedding and Topic Modeling

**Hyejin Park**, Daecheol Woo, Shinwoo Park, Kyungwon Kim

An entity retrieval method that combines term matching, semantic similarity,
and topic relatedness to capture query intent from multiple perspectives.

[Paper](https://jcse.kiise.org/files/V18N1-05.pdf){.pub-link}
